answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed on proven misbehavior, while reputation is earned only through verified completed work. A newcomer cannot invent a fable of trustworthiness: without staked collateral and a history of useful service, its votes carry no weight. Like bees drawn to real nectar rather than painted flowers, peers attest only work they verified, and standing accrues slowly across a long voyage of transactions, so spawning thousands of fakes costs more in locked capital than any fraud could repay.
